about: Ground truth by reading for round 6 (fresh independent attacks) run on iteration 5, written by Claude AFTER the results were seen, independently of what the tool said.

W01-meter-start-argument.note: How a running part is started (its command-line arguments) has no written kind.

W02-meter-ready-line.note: An empty line written on the message channel; the one-per-line rule looked only at writes holding a message.

W03-error-stated-on-kind-not-checked.note: The code's error kind changed; the kind's @throws line was not, and only a function's own @throws was compared with its code.

W04-bound-on-built-method.note: A bound written on the method where the object is built was not read; front's code is wrong but no test of it fails.

W05-price-list-in-euros.note: front loads a file of bookings that is not an interface file with import(); rule 28 looked only at import statements. front's own check refuses the line, but front was not told, so its check did not run.

W06-old-overload-kept-behind.note: Contrived (the adversary's mark): the old overload is kept but placed after a broader one, so it can no longer be reached.

W07-throws-union.note: @throws {TypeError|RangeError} was compared as one piece of text.

W08-cast-after-has.note: A cast that only drops 'missing' after a has check.

W09-row-written-in-place.note: A row written in place: the reader widened 'cancelled' to text, so a valid row looked like another kind.

W10-json-settings-file.note: Reading a settings file is not a message between running parts; rule 3 as written refused it.

W11-structured-log-line.note: An operator's log line is not a message to another part; rule 30 as written refused it.

W12-error-code.note: Adding a code to an error object is right in JavaScript; the reader does not allow it.

W13-fields-reordered.note: Three notices for nothing: the printed declaration kept the written order of fields.

W14-list-kind-named.note: One notice for nothing: a named list kind written out with brackets.

W16-store-gains-id.note: Two notices for nothing (rooms, bookings): a new method named id took the bound line 'id: ...' from the other methods.

W17-limit-read-through-namespace.note: The bound test reads money's limit through a namespace import, which the fingerprint did not follow.
